Strings.certificates.subtitle: Request and deploy TLS certificates
Strings.certificates.login_required: Sign in to a RelaxKonOS Server to manage its TLS certificates.
Strings.certificates.permission.read_required: Certificate access requires the Read TLS certificates permission.
Strings.certificates.permission.manage_required: Changing certificates requires the Manage TLS certificates permission.
Strings.certificates.validation.terms_required: You must accept the provider terms of service before requesting a certificate.
Strings.certificates.validation.email_required: A contact email is required for expiration notices.
Strings.certificates.validation.domains_required: Enter at least one domain, separated by commas.
Strings.certificates.validation.validity_days_in: Validity must be between 1 and 825 days.
Strings.certificates.request.title: Request a new certificate
Strings.certificates.self_signed.title: Create self-signed certificate
Strings.certificates.self_signed.help: This certificate is generated on this server and does not contact a certificate authority. Clients must trust it or verify its fingerprint.
Strings.certificates.request.help: Enter the primary domain and any subject alternative names separated by commas. HTTP-01 challenges require port 80 to be publicly reachable; DNS-01 requires a supported DNS provider on the server.
Strings.certificates.request.accept_terms: I accept the certificate provider's terms of service.
Strings.certificates.request.confirm_reachabilit: I confirm the domains are publicly reachable on port 80 (required for HTTP-01).
Strings.certificates.preflight.can_proceed: Preflight passed. You can request the certificate.
Strings.certificates.preflight.port80_available: Port 80 is reachable from the public internet.
Strings.certificates.preflight.port80_unavailabl: Port 80 is not reachable from the public internet.
Strings.certificates.preflight.requires_admin: The server requires administrator privileges for this challenge type.
Strings.certificates.operation.not_found: The server did not return a certificate operation status. Refresh and try again.
Strings.certificates.fingerprint.select_hint: Select a certificate to view its fingerprint
Strings.certificates.fingerprint.help: Compare this value character by character with the SHA-256 fingerprint shown by the client or browser to confirm it is your certificate.
Strings.certificates.list_hint: Select a certificate to deploy, renew, revoke, or delete it.
Strings.certificates.overview.total_hint: Managed certificates are kept on the RelaxKonOS RelaxKonOS.Server.
Strings.certificates.overview.safety_hint: Certificate requests run a server-side preflight before they contact the certificate authority. Private keys never leave the server.
